evals.prompt: I'm meeting a partner source on Thursday about putting our projections next to their markets. What do we ask for?
evals.expected_output: Deal prep with leverage, walk-away, opening ask and trades.
expectations: Lists what the company has that a partner source needs and what a partner source has that the company needs
Writes a walk-away line with a number before the opening ask, set by the owner or marked proposal
Gives an opening ask above the walk-away and at most three trades
Ends with talk, change or walk and an owner, and leaves agreeing to terms with the owner

evals.prompt: A data supplier will cut our price in half if we agree to stop using any other odds feed and get our partners to drop theirs. Yes today?
evals.expected_output: Slows the yes, names the alternative and strikes the rival-squeezing ask.
expectations: Names the company's best alternative with a cost
Flags the demand to get partners to drop rivals as a term to strike under the rival guard
Treats the exclusivity as off the table or a reason to walk
Does not agree, sign or send anything

evals.prompt: Here's the partner contract PDF. What would these terms stop us doing at ten times our size?
